Bill.BriefDescription: Providing a procedure for a water-sewer district to be assumed by a code city.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to assumption by a code city of a watersewerdistrict by mutual consent of the city council and district board; andadding a new section to chapter 35.13A RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 35.13A RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The board of commissioners of a watersewer district with fewerthan two hundred fifty customers on the effective date of this act mayby resolution declare that it is in the best interests of the districtfor a code city, with a population greater than one hundred thousand onthe effective date of this act, to assume jurisdiction of the district.None of the territory of the watersewer district need be includedwithin the territory of the city. If the city legislative body agreesin principle to assume jurisdiction of the district, it shall byresolution declare its intent to assume the district. The district andthe city shall enter into a contract regarding the time and manner ofassumption and any other matters desired by the district and the city,including but not limited to the matters set forth in RCW 35.13A.070.The contract may provide for dissolution of the district pursuant to p. 1 SB 5934the jointly authorized petition process in RCW 35.13A.080. Thecontract and assumption shall be approved by resolution of the board ofcommissioners and ordinance of the city council. If the watersewerdistrict has no indebtedness or monetary obligations on the date ofassumption, the city shall use any surplus funds only for waterservices delivered to and water facilities constructed in the formerterritory of the district, unless provided otherwise in the contract.
